description: Set the public profile shown on this account's author page and with its shared presets and comments, instead of its pseudonym alone: display name, link (https), a few words, the presets put first, where they are, more links, their instruments and a README. A field left out stays as it is; an empty one is cleared. Ask the user what they want shown; all of it is public.

about.description: Their README in Markdown: who they are, how they work, what they offer; 8000 characters at most.

bio.description: A few words about them and their sounds, 600 characters at most.

featured.description: Ids of their own listed presets, shown first on their page, in this order.

gear.description: The instruments they play, e.g. 'Korg minilogue'.

link.description: An https:// address: their site, SoundCloud, Bandcamp…

links.description: More https:// pages of theirs: a channel, a shop, a band.

location.description: Where they make music, 60 characters at most.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: set_profile
